title: Step 3b - Scikit-Learn: Building & Training Multiple Linear Regression Models

cues.en: Instructor: And now final step.
cues.zh: 現在最後一步。

cues.en: You know, with this line of code we actually built the Multiple Linear Regression model.
cues.zh: 這行程式已建立多元線性迴歸模型。

cues.en: So we have the model already.
cues.zh: 所以模型已經存在。

cues.en: Only right now it is dumb you know.
cues.zh: 但目前還什麼都不懂。

cues.en: It is not trained yet on the dataset.
cues.zh: 還沒有在資料集上訓練。

cues.en: So now we're gonna make it smart by training it indeed on our training set composed of remember X train and Y train.
cues.zh: 現在用訓練集，也就是 X_train 與 y_train，讓它學習。

cues.en: So there we go.
cues.zh: 開始。

cues.en: Let's take our regressor object from which we're gonna call the fit method which takes us input, right?
cues.zh: 取出 regressor，呼叫 fit，要傳入什麼？

cues.en: Exactly the same as before.
cues.zh: 和之前完全相同。

cues.en: First the matrix of features X train, and second, the dependent variable vector Y train of the training set, of course.
cues.zh: 先是訓練集的特徵矩陣 X_train，再是依變數向量 y_train。

cues.en: All right, And that's it.
cues.zh: 完成。

cues.en: This line of code will build our Multiple Linear Regression model and this line of code will train it on our training set.
cues.zh: 這行建立多元線性迴歸模型，下一行在訓練集上訓練。

cues.en: All right, perfect.
cues.zh: 很好。

cues.en: So now let's just execute the cells.
cues.zh: 現在執行儲存格。

cues.en: So let me check the cells that we didn't execute before.
cues.zh: 看看哪些還沒執行。

cues.en: So we executed everything up to here.
cues.zh: 前面已經執行到這裡。

cues.en: So we still have to execute this cell, you know to split indeed the data set into the training set and test set.
cues.zh: 還要執行這格，把資料切分成訓練集與測試集。

cues.en: And now we have the training set and therefore we can proceed to this next step to train the Multiple Linear Regression model on the training set.
cues.zh: 有了訓練集，就能進下一步，訓練多元線性迴歸。

cues.en: So here we go. Let's do it. Click and play. And there we go.
cues.zh: 來做，點執行。好了。

cues.en: We now have a fully trained linear regression model on this data set.
cues.zh: 現在有了在這份資料上訓練完成的線性迴歸模型。

cues.en: So now we have a model that was trained to understand the correlations between different types of spends by 50 startups and their profit,
cues.zh: 它已學習 50 家新創不同支出與利潤之間的關係，

cues.en: so that now investors can deploy this model on new startups in order to predict what profit they will generate based on these informations.
cues.zh: 投資人就能把模型套用到新公司，根據相同資訊預測利潤。

cues.en: All right, perfect. So congratulations.
cues.zh: 恭喜。

cues.en: Now let's recap. You know three things.
cues.zh: 現在回顧三件事。

cues.en: Thanks to this amazing linear regression class you don't have to worry about the dummy variable trap.
cues.zh: 多虧這個 LinearRegression 類別，不必擔心虛擬變數陷阱。

cues.en: You don't either have to worry about selecting the best features, meaning the features with the highest P value, or the most statistically significant.
cues.zh: 講者也認為，不必另選他所說 p 值最高、或最具統計顯著性的特徵。

cues.en: The linear regression class will take care of that as well.
cues.zh: 他表示 LinearRegression 類別也會處理這部分。

cues.en: And also, you know how to build and train a Multiple Linear Regression model on a data set, which you also know how to pre-process like a pro.
cues.zh: 另外，你已學會建立並訓練多元線性迴歸，也能熟練準備資料。

cues.en: All right, so we're now gonna move on to the last step, which will be to predict the test set results because remember that so far our model was trained on the training set,
cues.zh: 接下來最後一步，預測測試集結果，因為目前只在訓練集上訓練，

cues.en: and therefore we still need to check its performance on new observations which are contained in the test set.
cues.zh: 仍需要檢查對新觀測值，也就是測試集的表現。

cues.en: However, here we have to understand something important.
cues.zh: 但這裡有一件重要的事。

cues.en: You know, compared to what we did in the previous section on simple linear regression.
cues.zh: 與上一章簡單線性迴歸相比，

cues.en: This time we actually have several features, right?
cues.zh: 這次有多個特徵。

cues.en: We actually have four features instead of one, like before.
cues.zh: 確切地說，有四個，不再只有一個。

cues.en: And therefore we cannot actually plot a graph like we did in simple in our regression, where, you know, we have the features and the X axis and the dependent variable and the Y axis,
cues.zh: 因此，不能像簡單線性迴歸一樣，直接把特徵放 x 軸，依變數放 y 軸，

cues.en: because simply there are four features.
cues.zh: 因為有四個特徵。

cues.en: We would need actually a five dimensional graph, which is not possible to visualize as humans.
cues.zh: 那會需要五維圖，人類無法直接視覺化。

cues.en: So what we're gonna do instead you know, instead of visualizing the test set results on a plot, well we will actually display two vectors.
cues.zh: 所以，不用圖表，而是顯示兩個向量。

cues.en: The first one is the vectors of the real profit in the test set.
cues.zh: 第一個是測試集的實際利潤。

cues.en: And remember that the test set actually counts for 20% of the whole data set.
cues.zh: 測試集占整份資料的 20%。

cues.en: And therefore since here, there are, you know actually 50 observations corresponding to the 50 startups.
cues.zh: 共有 50 筆觀測值，對應 50 家新創。

cues.en: Well, 20% of 50 will be 10 observations in the test set.
cues.zh: 50 的 20%，就是十筆測試觀測值。

cues.en: So we will actually have 10 samples in a test set and we will display two vectors.
cues.zh: 因此測試集有十個樣本，我們顯示兩個向量。

cues.en: First, a vector of the 10 real profits from the test set.
cues.zh: 先是十筆實際利潤。

cues.en: You know, the 10 ground truth.
cues.zh: 也就是真實答案。

cues.en: And a second vector of the 10 predicted profits of the same test set so that we can compare for each startup of the test set if our predicted profit is close to the real profit.
cues.zh: 再來是同一份測試集的十筆預測利潤，逐家公司比較，看看預測是否接近實際。

cues.en: And that's how we will, you know, evaluate our model.
cues.zh: 這就是目前評估模型的方式。

cues.en: And then later on in this part, you will actually learn about some evaluation techniques to measure better the performance of your regression models with some relevant metrics.
cues.zh: 這部分後面還會教更正式的評估技術，用適當指標衡量迴歸模型效能。

cues.en: But so far, this is how we will do it.
cues.zh: 但現在先這樣做。

cues.en: We will clearly see if, you know, our model performs well on new observations, you know, on the test set because we will clearly see if the predictions are closed to the real results, okay?
cues.zh: 直接看預測是否接近實際結果，就能初步了解模型對測試集新資料的表現。

cues.en: So you can try to do it yourself, at least the first step which is to get the vector of predicted profits, but then in order to display the two vectors, you know, next to each other,
cues.zh: 可以先試著自己做，至少先取得預測利潤向量；至於將兩個向量並排，

cues.en: while we'll have to use some certain tricks which are not necessarily obvious.
cues.zh: 需要一些比較不直觀的技巧。

cues.en: So we'll do that together. All right.
cues.zh: 我們會一起完成。

cues.en: So as soon as you're ready, let's proceed to the next tutorial.
cues.zh: 準備好，就進下一堂課。

cues.en: And until then, enjoy machine learning.
cues.zh: 在此之前，享受機器學習吧。
